label: Cybersecurity readiness gap by property size
question: Are small hotels prepared for AI-era security risks?
answer: 94% of properties with 250+ staff feel prepared for cybersecurity threats, against 60% of those with fewer than ten.
sample: European accommodation providers by size band
methodology: Booking.com European Accommodation Barometer, February–March 2026. Self-assessed preparedness, which typically overstates readiness at both ends.
